subject: No Zoom. No meeting. Still a group.
preview: Same chapter. Same community. Your schedule.

blocks.text: When I say "group Bible study," you probably picture a meeting.
Tuesday at 7.
A Zoom link. Or a living room full of folding chairs.
And right away the questions start.
What if I am still at work?
What if the kids need me?
What if I live in a different time zone?
What happens when I miss a week?
For a lot of people, that is where it ends.
Not because they do not want to study the Bible. Because their life does not fit the meeting.
So the Wisdom of Proverbs does not have one.
No Zoom.
No live meeting.
No time you have to be online.
It is still a group study. We are just not together because we are in the same room at the same time.
We are together because we are in the same chapter.
Take October 5. Everyone is on Proverbs 5 that day.
One person reads it at 6 in the morning with a cup of coffee.
Another reads it on a lunch break.
Someone else opens it at 10:30 at night, after the kids finally fall asleep.
They answer the same questions. They end up in the same conversation.
Different schedules. Same chapter. Same community.
And if you miss a day, it does not disappear. Every day that has opened stays open, so you can catch up.
Proverbs actually has a picture for this. "Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise."
The ant has no one standing over her with a schedule. She just keeps showing up, a little at a time.
One chapter a day, whenever your day has room for it. That is the whole idea.

closing: It is completely free, and it fits around your life instead of the other way around.
